text:
All three Gate 2 revisions have been applied and validated across `header.json`, `units-001.json`, `units-002.json`, and `units-003.json`:

1. **`U38` & `U39` (Separate `minor` changesets)**: Split the frontend changeset into `U38` (`.changeset/catalog-entity-redirect.md` for `@backstage/plugin-catalog: minor`) and `U39` (`.changeset/techdocs-entity-redirect.md` for `@backstage/plugin-techdocs: minor`), each describing only its own package.
2. **`U18` (`useExternalRedirect.ts` Rule 1)**: Explicitly lists every retained and added import with its module specifier (`useEffect`, `useRef` from `'react'`; `useLocation`, `useNavigate`, `useParams` from `'react-router-dom'`; `useAsync` from `'react-use/esm/useAsync'`; `alertApiRef`, `useApi`, `useApiHolder`, `useRouteRef` from `'@backstage/core-plugin-api'`; `catalogApiRef` from `'@backstage/plugin-catalog-react'`; `CompoundEntityRef`, `parseEntityRef`, `stringifyEntityRef` from `'@backstage/catalog-model'`; `buildTechDocsURL` from `'@backstage/plugin-techdocs-react'`; `TECHDOCS_EXTERNAL_ANNOTATION` from `'@backstage/plugin-techdocs-common'`; and `rootDocsRouteRef` from `'../../../routes'`).
3. **`U17` (`useEntityFromUrl.ts` Rule 4)**: Wraps the `catalogApi.getEntityRedirectByRef?.({ kind, namespace, name })` lookup in a `try { ... } catch { ... }` block so any error during redirect resolution is caught and falls back to `{ entity: undefined, redirectUrl: undefined }` (the existing not-found state), while errors from `getEntityByRef` itself continue to surface via `useAsyncRetry`.
